title: Am I Invisible?
description: An original quiet emotional short about Maya feeling unnoticed in a rainy cafe. An empty chair and her drawings carry the story. Leo and Max are ordinary imperfect people, not villains. Show specific silent actions, a setback, and a small earned moment of connection. No literal invisibility, shadow monster, counters, lecture or forced joke. Keep dialogue sparse and the ending hopeful without claiming loneliness is cured.
